messages:
Ava (PM): Customer asks: shareable console view for auditors showing per-model cost, error clusters with sample traces, and a trace tag for model_id. Need an MVP for next sprint.
Ravi (Eng-ML): Adding model_id span tag is quick. Accurate per-token billing requires a data join later.
Sana (SRE): Constraints: default PII redaction, retention 30d, sampling default 0.5%, canary rollout 48h. No ship without redaction + canary.
Olivia (DevEx): UX: single shareable URL, CSV export. If backend provides endpoints I can mock UI in ~2d.
Ava (PM): Proposed MVP-lite: (1) span tags: model_id + route, (2) dashboard: estimated daily cost tile (labeled provisional), latency p50/p95, error rate, filter by model_id, (3) error analytics: grouped errors + 3 sample traces per group, (4) CSV export skeleton, (5) canary single-runtime 48h + redaction.
Ravi (Eng-ML): With mocked cost tile ETA ~10 dev-days total. If we need faster, cut samples to 1-2 and limit to one runtime for canary.
Sana (SRE): Agree on cuts. I'll add alert rule: if canary error_rate > baseline *1.8 for 30m, page oncall.
Ava (PM): Decision: ship MVP-lite with mocked cost, 3 samples per error group, single-runtime canary, default 0.5% sampling. I'll open ticket OBS-904 and attach acceptance checklist.
observability-bot: OBS-904 created and assigned to Eng-ML.
Olivia (DevEx): Will attach UI mock + CSV schema by EOD.
Ravi (Eng-ML): Splitting tasks and scheduling for sprint.
Ava (PM): Acceptance checklist will include perf overhead <=3% p99, redaction verified, and docs + runbook available before full rollout.
